report: Osmani TV — DELETE USER + Legacy Subscription production verification
scope_note: Verification + correction only. No redesign, no migration, no feature. Every prior production fix preserved.

objective_1_delete_user.question: Is DELETE USER (A) only another name for soft revoke, or (B) a true authoritative subscription removal?
objective_1_delete_user.answer: B — authoritative removal, implemented as a history-preserving revoke (payment + audit history intentionally kept per requirement).
objective_1_delete_user.was_it_merely_soft_revoke: No. The word 'soft' only describes that the row and payments are NOT hard-deleted. The entitlement effect is authoritative and permanent.
how_it_is_authoritative: device_subscriptions.status set to 'revoked' and admin_revoked_at set (revokeAdminDeviceSubscription).
active_now / remaining_seconds / remaining_days SQL all require admin_revoked_at IS NULL, so the App loses Premium immediately and remaining days become 0 (forceZero).
verify (/api/subscription-status, /api/subscription/verify), SSE snapshot, and Admin all report active:false, status:'revoked', remaining_days:0, admin_revoked:true.
isAdminRevokedOrderBlocked blocks: the exact revoked order; ANY order created at/before admin_revoked_at; and any order with unknown created_at (fail-closed). No stale finalize/webhook can restore.
Only a brand-new payment created AFTER admin_revoked_at restores access, which creates a new entitlement and clears admin_revoked_* (upsertDeviceSubscriptionActive).
notifyAdminSubscriptionRevoked invalidates the access cache and clears the verify singleflight so no stale ACTIVE is re-served.
objective_1_delete_user.code_change_needed_this_task: None. DELETE USER was already authoritative from the prior stabilization; re-verified live.

live_evidence.delete_contract: DELETE /api/users/8b94b929d89681a1 -> {deleted:true, subscription_removed:true, active:false, status:'revoked', entitlement_state:'inactive', transactions_preserved:true, cache_invalidated:true, sse_broadcast:true, deletedSubscription:0, deletedTransactions:0}
live_evidence.sse_snapshot: {active:false, status:'revoked', remaining_days:0, inactive_reason:'admin_revoked', admin_revoked:true, expiresAt preserved}
live_evidence.permanence: Previously-revoked device 8b94b929d89681a1 remains revoked/inactive over time — no auto-restore without a new payment.

finding_A_value_canonicalization.status: Already fixed in the prior stabilization; re-verified consistent across every API.
finding_A_value_canonicalization.verify_vs_admin_lookup_vs_panel_search: IDENTICAL — plan_name 'MWENZI 1', amount 5000, plan_duration_days 30, remaining_days 1850, expires_at 2031-08-19, is_stacked_entitlement true.
finding_A_value_canonicalization.policy: Canonical plan metadata (plan_id, plan_name, amount, plan_duration_days) is bound to the entitlement transaction; remaining_days is derived from the real stored expiry; over-credit is flagged via is_stacked_entitlement. Expiry is NOT rewritten.

finding_B_root_cause_this_task.title: Legacy Device IDs invisible to Admin lookup / search / Delete User
finding_B_root_cause_this_task.root_cause: The operational-device gate (adminUserLookup.isExactDeviceId / isCanonicalOperationalDeviceId) and the paginated subscription search (adminUsersList.appendSubscriptionSearch) hard-required a 64-hex Device ID. Real production clients also use 16-hex Android SSAID (ANDROID_ID) and 36-char installation UUIDs. Additionally a 16-hex id yields >=9 extracted digits, so it was mis-routed to the phone-number search branch and never matched by device_id — returning found:false / 0 rows even though the device is active.
finding_B_root_cause_this_task.impact: 486 sixteen-hex rows (127 active) + 215 installation-UUID rows were unfindable in Admin lookup and the Admin Panel search box, and could not be deleted by exact Device ID via those paths.
finding_B_root_cause_this_task.over_credited_legacy_expiries: 58 over-credited + 86 minor-over-credited active subscriptions carry stored expiries beyond a single-plan replay (e.g. a 30-day/5000 MWENZI 1 payment on 2026-06-16 stored expiry 2031-08-19). These are historical activation/stacking/migration data anomalies. Per instructions they were NOT rewritten; responses expose canonical plan metadata + is_stacked_entitlement and derive remaining_days from the untouched expiry.

objective_2_legacy_subscriptions.records_corrected_note: Zero database rows modified. The correction is at the response/query layer only (recognize real Device ID shapes for lookup/search). No expiry, no duration, no valid subscription changed.

files_changed: server/src/lib/adminUserLookup.js — recognize 16/32/64-hex + installation UUID as canonical operational Device IDs (keep synthetic-forensic exclusion); relax phone->device resolution SQL from 64-only to all real shapes.
server/src/lib/adminUsersList.js — appendSubscriptionSearch: exact match lower(ds.device_id)=$ for any real Device ID shape BEFORE the phone branch; never treat a hex id (contains a-f) as a phone.
server/scripts/test-users-lookup-operational.mjs — updated assertions: legacy 16-hex SSAID + installation UUID accepted, malformed/synthetic rejected.

deploy/contabo/apply-cutover.sh — DEPLOY PIPELINE FIX: startup smoke test ran import('./src/loadEnv.js') from ROOT (loadEnv.js is in server/), so with set -e it exited BEFORE the PM2 restart. The last two deploys pulled code to disk but never restarted PM2. Now runs the smoke test from API_DIR in a subshell so PM2 restart always executes.
database_queries_changed: adminUserLookup.resolveDeviceIdsForPhone: WHERE length=64 AND ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'  ->  match 16/32/64-hex OR UUID (8-4-4-4-12).
adminUsersList.appendSubscriptionSearch: exact device branch changed from /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/ only to all real shapes with lower(ds.device_id) = $; phone branch gated to non-hex queries.
api_endpoints_affected_behavior_only: GET /api/users/lookup?q=<deviceId> — now returns canonical subscription for legacy 16-hex / UUID devices (was found:false).
GET /api/users?search=<deviceId> (paginated Admin list) — now returns the row for legacy device IDs (was 0 results).
GET /api/subscription-status, POST /api/subscription/verify, GET /api/subscription-stream, DELETE /api/users/:id — UNCHANGED; re-verified correct.

delete_user_8b94b929.after: re-confirmed authoritative + permanent; SSE inactive; expiry preserved

confirmations.no_subscription_duration_added_or_remove: CONFIRMED. Active subscriptions ~254 unchanged; expiry categories unchanged (58 over / 86 minor-over — only natural day-boundary drift). Example expiries preserved exactly: f55886a3 = 2031-08-19, 8b94b929 = 2026-07-28. Zero DB rows modified.
confirmations.delete_user_permanent_until_new_payment: CONFIRMED. Revoked devices stay inactive with remaining_days 0; isAdminRevokedOrderBlocked blocks same-order, at/before-revoke, and unknown-created_at orders (fail-closed); only a payment created AFTER admin_revoked_at restores access.
